Aileen Villas Layan

Villa in Layan
HomeSaleAileen Villas Layan

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Phase 5 of the Aileen Villas Layan community by Trinity Property, offering 3 and 4 bedroom private-pool villas of roughly 270 to 470 sqm. Larger types add a terrace pool or extra laundry and storage rooms. Sources disagree on whether the phase is finished or still to be completed.

Aileen Villas Layan: key facts

  • Aileen Villas Layan is a pool villa in Layan, Phuket, developed by Trinity Property Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 270–470 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿17,500,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Layan Beach (about 5 minutes, driving).
  • More projects by Trinity Property in our catalogue: Aileen Rawai Townhouses.

Facilities & amenities

  • Private pool in each villa
  • Parking

Frequently asked questions

Where is Aileen Villas Layan?

Aileen Villas Layan is a pool villa project in Layan, Phuket, developed by Trinity Property Co., Ltd..

What is the starting price of Aileen Villas Layan?

The advertised starting price is ฿17,500,000, last checked 2026-11-12. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Aileen Villas Layan?

Current status: completed. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
